name: DepShield MCP
description: Acts as a security checkpoint for AI coding agents by intercepting package installations to verify existence, check against CVE databases, and block vulnerable or hallucinated dependencies before they reach your codebase. Provides seven security tools including pre-install gates, full project audits, safe version recommendations, and deep transitive dependency scanning for npm and PyPI packages.
